authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6914 nakha explicitly gives nahu/naũh and Palula nōṅg nail under its first branch; retained velar clusters there must not be mechanically reassigned to *nakkha. Chil nōr needs a local rhotic account. Reviewed comparator: Phal nā̃ŋg “fingernail” (f_42kiftmb6b6xy). Uncertain intra-IA transmission remains open; exact source text is preserved.

Reviewed comparator: Kho gṓm “wheat (husked)” (f_qbw2sm4md756e). Uncertain intra-IA transmission remains open; exact source text is preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9828 manuṣya explicitly gives Bshk mīš/mĩš young man/husband with plural mānuš, and Palula mēš/mīš. These particular short-i forms are supported by the full entry; this does not resolve the separate Khowar moš ambiguity. Reviewed comparator: Chil meś “man” (f_axjoqhxqcvorq). Uncertain intra-IA transmission remains open; exact source text is preserved.
